question: Compound X is used in glass and soap industry. Ten molecules of water of crystallisation are present in this compound. The pH value of its solution is higher than 7. Identify compound X.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Washing soda.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Washing soda** is also known as **sodium carbonate decahydrate** and has** ten molecules** of **water of crystallisation.**
 
• The** pH value** of its solution is **higher than 7,** which means it is** basic** in nature.
 
• Washing soda is used in the glass and soap industry as it acts as a** water softener **and helps in removing hard water stains.
 
• It is also used in** laundry detergents** as it enhances the **cleaning properties** of the detergent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Baking soda** is also known as **sodium bicarbonate **and has only one molecule of water of crystallisation.

 
 
• It is used in **baking, as a cleaning agent, and as an antacid.**
 
 
 
• **Bleaching powder** is** calcium hypochlorite** and is used as a** disinfectant and bleaching agent.**
 
• **Sodium hydroxide** is also known as** caustic soda** and is a **strong base**.
 
 
• It is used in the manufacture of **soaps, detergents, and paper.**
